_comment: Global parameters for the LEGPROG-516 metadata volume model. Every value records its source; see README.md.

patients_per_daily_report.source: LEGPROG-516 decisions, 2026-10-28 (500 unique patients per facility per day)

patients_per_monthly_report.source: LEGPROG-516 decisions, 2026-10-28 (5,000 unique patients per facility per month)

census_patients_per_facility_month.source: LEGPROG-516 decisions, 2026-10-28 (facility-level unique patients per month)

inhouse_patients_per_facility.source: Derived (LEGPROG-516 decision, 2026-11-11): patients still admitted at a period boundary, N, from N + admissions/day = patients_per_daily_report and N + days_per_month x admissions/day = patients_per_monthly_report (about 345). null derives it; --set overrides it

share_reportable.source: LEGPROG-516 decision, 2026-11-11: share of patient-report entries in the measure's Initial Population (they get a supplemental pass and validation)

resources_per_patient.source: LEGPROG-516 decision, 2026-11-11: resources acquired per patient-report entry, both phases

days_per_month.source: Convention for rates; windows are calendar months in the product

completion_lag_days.source: Placeholder; LEGLINK-1369 measures period end to terminal report status. Should be at least the processing window chosen from peak_processing_windows_hours plus downstream time

reference_window_months.source: LEGPROG-516 decisions, 2026-10-28 (analyze at one month, then scale)

window_cap_months.source: ADR 08 / LEGLINK-1242 maximum; windows above it are flagged

peak_processing_windows_hours.source: LEGPROG-516 decision, 2026-11-11: swept; the acceptable window to process an end-of-period batch is an output of LEGPROG-516

kafka_retention_days.source: Placeholder: Kafka broker default (168 h); production value is an output of LEGPROG-516

kafka_replication_factor.source: Placeholder: typical production value; local compose uses 1

loki_retention_days.source: Placeholder; production value is an output of LEGPROG-516

retention_participants.source: LEGLINK-1242 draft: PI 3 default participants (Report, MeasureEval, Validation, DataAcquisition)
